Name: Pet Life Unlimited Dry Shampoo Refillable Applicator for Dogs, Blue
Description: Pet parents, say goodbye to the hassle of giving your dog a bath with Pet Life Unlimited Dry Shampoo Refillable Applicator for Dogs! This clever tool is the perfect between-bath solution for your furry friend. No more chasing your pup around the house when it’s time for a bath, as this deep-clean dry shampoo system allows you to freshen up your dog without any mess or fuss. The refillable applicator brush is designed to work with the waterless Dry Shampoo Powder Refills (sold separately), making it easy to clean and deodorize your dog’s coat and skin. The soft and flexible bristles not only remove dirt and loose hair but also provide a gentle massage for your pup. And with its click-close cap, it’s perfect for on-the-go use, whether it’s a trip to the dog park or an overnight stay. Plus, it comes with a starter packet of Dry Shampoo Powder Refill, which has a delightful scent that will leave your dog smelling fresh and clean.
